subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding interest charges on unpaid credit card balances and why carrying a balance costs extra
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student calculates how a small unpaid credit balance grows over a few simulated months due to interest
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a paid-in-full scenario versus a carried-balance scenario to their different total costs
exercise.abstract: Student explains why paying a credit card balance in full avoids extra cost

misconception_flags: believes carrying a credit balance costs the same as paying it off immediately

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
